topic: Operation Mincemeat -- a dead man's fake identity fooled Hitler into moving his army away from Sicily
title: The Dead Man Who Fooled Hitler Into Moving His Entire Army
description: AI-narrated history commentary: the true story of Operation Mincemeat, the WWII deception that used a dead man's body and a fabricated identity to trick Nazi Germany into moving real troops away from the actual 1943 invasion of Sicily.

hook_candidates.text: The corpse that fooled Hitler into moving his entire army.
What if the agent who tricked Hitler had been dead for weeks before the mission even started?
You think Britain's best WWII spy was a trained agent. He was a homeless man who had already died.
In 1943, a Spanish fisherman found a drowned British officer, except the officer had never actually existed.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who has watched every WWII documentary ever made, because they want to prove one trick even those documentaries missed.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume the agent who fooled Hitler and his whole army was a trained spy, not a dead man.
closing_comment: The dead man who fooled Hitler had a real name, Glyndwr Michael, and he never once volunteered for war.

sources.note: Confirms Glyndwr Michael's body, the fake 'Major William Martin' identity, and the fabricated fiancee/debt letters.
Confirms Spanish authorities passed the documents to German intelligence and Hitler shifted troops away from Sicily.
